marta_ops: Heads up: FRA dock blocked — forwarder says pallet couldn't be offloaded. AWB HA1234567890. 6 H100 units; manifest shows 4 sealed, 2 damaged on inspection. Need RMA flow and ETA for replacements. @raj_sourcing @ines_vendor
raj_sourcing: On it. Opening with vendor now. Do we have photos + serials for the 2 damaged?
marta_ops: Uploading photos and quick manifest in thread. serials: SN-H100-FF1234, SN-H100-FF1235. photos -> https://redwood-internal.s3/infra/ha1234_images.zip
LogisticsBot: AWB HA1234567890 status: 'Blocked - Depot'. ETA to clear port gate: +24–48h. Estimated container inspect slot: tomorrow 09:00 CET.
nines_vendor: Sorry about the hold. Vendor contact: Ines (on call). We'll request expedited partial air replacement for the 2 DOA units. Need RMA authorization number from you to proceed.

nines_vendor: Sorry about the hold. Vendor contact: Ines (on call). We'll request expedited partial air replacement for the 2 DOA units. Need RMA authorization number from you to proceed.
marta_ops: Can we get RMA pre-approval? We need replacement ETA <= 5 business days, otherwise we escalate to air. Also confirm insurance claim starts when RMA is accepted.
raj_sourcing: I asked finance for insurance deductible & approval. @ines_vendor — cost recap: we prefer vendor-covered expedited air if root cause is transit damage. Can you confirm vendor absorbs freight?
nines_vendor: If inspection shows transit damage, vendor covers freight and expedited air. We need depot photo evidence & official inspection note. I'll provision RMA ID once we have that.
rachel_sre: Heads-up: cluster scheduling impacted — 6 units offline, one of our capacity pools will underprovision by ~12% starting tonight. Please tag priority.
marta_ops: :thumbsup: tagging priority. Log: `impact: pool-gpu-east-fra-01 -12%`
raj_sourcing: Attached inspection report snippet:
```
Depot: FRA-DC-7
Inspector: Jens
Damage: crushed corner, bent heatsink on 2 units
Photos: uploaded
```
@ines_vendor can you issue tentative RMA-2026-374?
ines_vendor: RMA issued: RMA-2026-374 (tentative). We'll push for same-day air pickup once confirm. Please send AWB return label request and confirm whether we should consolidate replacements with a separate AWB or reuse HA1234567890.
marta_ops: Return labels needed. Prefer separate AWB for replacements to avoid customs hold on original. Please provide return label PDF to ops@redwood.com. Also add `PO-8342` on paperwork.
ines_vendor: Understood. We'll generate replacement AWB: WHREPL-HA9876543210. Estimated ship date: in 48h if inspection accepted. I'll confirm carrier and tracking once booked.
LogisticsBot: Note: customs HS code clarification needed for air shipments from vendor -> DE. Suggest including commercial invoice with `HS:84715000` and 'Used, tested' if refurb.
marta_ops: Copy, will annotate. One last ask: can vendor expedite serial-level replacement (same firmware batch)? We want to avoid compatibility regressions.
ines_vendor: We'll prioritize same-batch units; marking `match-firmware: preferred` in the release. If unavailable, we provide full spec sheet for approvals.
raj_sourcing: Finance confirms vendor freight covered pending claim. If vendor delays, we will bill chargeback per contract SLA.
marta_ops: Thanks all. I'll follow up here when depot clears and inspection is finalized.
